cover_letter:
Dear prado team,

I'm excited to apply for the front-end developer (Shopify) position. Your mission to build invisible home technology for leading architects, and your rapid growth across Europe, North America, and the Middle East, resonate with my passion for creating seamless digital experiences. The opportunity to own the front end of multiple webshops and contribute to prado 2.0 aligns perfectly with my skills and ambitions.

At Episto, I build and maintain client websites, focusing on performance, SEO, and user experience. I work with WordPress, Elementor, and Astra, but more importantly, I understand how to translate design requirements into functional, responsive sites. On my personal project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page site from scratch, implemented structured data (JSON-LD), and conducted technical audits to improve search visibility. This hands-on experience has given me a strong eye for detail and a knack for optimizing site performance.

Earlier, as a front-end developer at ViviDoctor, I developed features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. This role honed my ability to write clean, maintainable code and collaborate with cross-functional teams. I'm comfortable with Git, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and I'm eager to deepen my expertise in Shopify's Liquid and Online Store 2.0. While I haven't worked with Shopify yet, my technical background and quick learning curve mean I can quickly become productive.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, just a short commute from Ghent, and I'm fluent in English with Dutch at B1 level (currently improving). I thrive in collaborative environments and am excited about the prospect of working with designers, content creators, and performance marketers to bring campaigns to life. I'm confident that my blend of front-end skills and marketing sensibility would make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to prado's continued success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
